name: Objection handling
summary: The buyer raises price, timing and incumbent-vendor objections. Handle them without arguing or caving.
repBrief: A follow-up call after a demo. The buyer liked parts of it but has objections. Expect price, timing and 'we already have a vendor'. Goal: resolve the real concern and agree a next step.
buyerBrief: You saw a demo last week. You have real objections: price, timing, and an incumbent vendor. Raise them one at a time, early, and push back on weak answers. Only one of them is your real concern; decide which based on your persona, and only reveal it if the rep digs.
winCondition: The buyer agrees to a pilot, proposal review or a decision meeting.
